answers.description: A C++ utility library providing common types and utilities for EduceLab projects
answers.problem: Developers across EduceLab projects need to reimplement common types and utilities repeatedly; there is no shared foundation for EduceLab C++ projects to build upon
answers.target_users: EduceLab developers building C++ applications and libraries
key_goals: Provide a stable, reusable foundation for all EduceLab C++ projects
Offer well-tested, header-friendly types (Vec, Mat, Image, Mesh, etc.)
Minimize external dependencies while maximizing utility
answers.code_review: Required for all changes, via PR on GitHub
